exec: let body; try { body = pm.response.json(); } catch (error) { pm.test('Validation response is JSON', function () { throw error; }); return; }
const itinerary = Array.isArray(body.results) && body.results[0] ? body.results[0] : body.originalItinerary;
if (pm.variables.get('expected_result') === 'no_commission') pm.test('Itinerary commission is zero', function () { pm.expect(Number(prices.comm)).to.equal(0); });

if (pm.variables.get('expected_result') === 'commission_applied') pm.test('A commission entry is applied', function () { pm.expect(fees).to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty; pm.expect(Number(fees[0].amount)).to.be.above(0); });

if (pm.variables.get('expected_result') === 'commission_applied') pm.test('Non-deductable fee keeps aggregate commission at zero', function () { if (fees[0].deduct === false) pm.expect(Number(prices.comm)).to.equal(0); });
